name: Extraction
goal_hint: Collect the requested information from pages into clean structured output.
strategy: For lazy pages scroll before extracting
Output as a table with consistent columns
verification: All requested rows collected; columns consistent; counts match the page.
failure_handling: If the page paginates, follow pagination up to a reasonable limit; if blocked, note it.
prompt_extra: Respect the site: no rapid-fire scraping; extract at a human-like pace.
